newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean environment agency chief quits.
newsitem.headline: Chilean environment agency chief quits.

text.p: The executive director of Chile's National Environment Commission (Conama), Vivianne Blanlot, has resigned, said a top government official Friday.
Juan Villarzu, secretary general to the presidency, told reporters that Blanlot resigned Thursday but declined to give any reasons for her decision.

Local media reported that Blanlot decided to leave after arguments with ministers and companies over environment conditions for several projects including the controversial Ralco dam and Trillium forestry schemes.
